NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NO. PL 215/2026 (COASTAL)
CATEGORY: THE PRESENCE OF LONG TOWS
AREA: SOUTHERN BALTIC. LOCALISATION: POLISH COAST. CHART INT1021.
ON 2026-09-07 AND 2026-09-08 THE TOWING OPERATION OF 750M LONG SILTING PIPE WILL BE CONDUCTED BY VESSELS HENRYK (MMSI: 261059000) AND SM-PRC-101 OR SM-PRC-107 FROM JASTARNIA POSITION: 54-43.10N 018-38.10E TO PUSTKOWO POSITION: 54-04.50N 014-58.50E. FISHERMEN ARE ASKED TO REMOVE FISHING GEARS FROM THE TOWING ROUTE.
TERM OF VALIDITY: FROM 07 SEP 2026, 02:00 (UTC)
REMARKS: CAUTION ADVISED.
PROMULGATED 06 SEP 2026. HYDROGRAPHIC OFFICE OF THE POLISH NAVY, POLISH COORDINATOR OF RADIO NAVIGATIONAL WARNINGS.
note: Typ BHMW: Brzegowe/Coastal. Przepisane z PDF (telefon); układ formularza spłaszczony. PL czasy CET == CEST (UTC+2), EN w UTC.
